hunt.justification: Ransomware represents a critical risk to business continuity. Identifying the transition from credential abuse to malicious endpoint activity before full encryption is complete provides the only window for effective containment.

stages.name: Sign-in via Stolen Credentials
observables: Successful authentication using established user accounts

stages.name: System Binary Proxy Execution
observables: Execution of signed Windows binaries (e.g., rundll32.exe, mshta.exe, certutil.exe) with malicious command line arguments
Unusual parent-child process relationships involving system tools
Loading of unsigned or suspicious modules by trusted binaries

stages.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
observables: High-volume file write and delete operations
Presence of ransomware notes in multiple directories

scenario.summary: This intrusion scenario involves an attacker using stolen credentials to gain initial access before leveraging native Windows binaries to proxy the execution of malicious code. The final stage of the attack involves the deployment of ransomware to encrypt local data for impact.

meta.rationale: Start with network and remote interactive logons. Focus on servers and domain-admin workstations where impact is highest.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder has used stolen credentials to gain initial access and is now using signed system binaries to proxy execution and encrypt files across the estate.

blind_spots.risk: A sign-in on an unmonitored provider would bypass the lead query, preventing the gated investigation from starting.
blind_spots.question: whether a user signed in via a provider not currently integrated
blind_spots.requires: hb_auth_signin coverage for all identity providers

blind_spots.risk: Attackers can hide within unmonitored hosts; file operations may still alert us, but the source process would remain unknown.
blind_spots.question: whether a LOLBin was used on a host without an agent

blind_spots.risk: A high count of file writes can be benign (e.g., updates or backups); without entropy, we rely on count alone as a behavioral proxy.
blind_spots.question: whether the file writes are actually encrypted content

hunt.name: Credential-driven LOLBin Proxying and Ransomware
hunt.description: This hunt follows a gated flow to first identify anomalous successful sign-ins as a cheap lead. If an account shows signs of takeover, the hunt opens an expensive search for behavioral evidence: the use of signed system binaries (LOLBins) to proxy malicious execution and high-volume file operations characteristic of ransomware encryption. An agent then correlates the initial access with the endpoint activity to isolate the host before encryption completes.

config.scoping_notes: Start with network and remote interactive logons. Focus on servers and domain-admin workstations where impact is highest.
config.beyond_detection: A simple rule might catch rundll32.exe with a DLL; this hunt pivots from an anomalous sign-in to a rare process to mass file operations, requiring an analyst and agent to correlate three distinct telemetry surfaces.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, logon_type, status_code, status_id, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 1 AND logon_type IN ('Network', 'Remote Interactive') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify successful authentications from network or remote interactive sessions as a lead for potential credential abuse.
config.expected_signal: A list of successful logons. Silence means no network-based logons occurred in the window.

primitive_config.label: Suspicious successful sign-ins
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, logon_type, status_code, status_id, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 1 AND logon_type IN ('Network', 'Remote Interactive') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A list of successful logons. Silence means no network-based logons occurred in the window.

config.objective: Examine the sign-in results and identify any accounts or source IPs that appear anomalous for the environment.
config.description: Analyze the lead query results to decide if the sign-in activity warrants an expensive follow-on investigation.
config.expected_signal: A verdict on whether any sign-in looks suspicious enough to investigate the endpoint.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict of suspicious or benign.

config.question: the evaluate-lead verdict is suspicious for at least one host
config.condition: the evaluate-lead verdict is suspicious for at least one host
config.description: Route the hunt based on the first agent's evaluation of the lead.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{lolbin_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%.dll%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%http%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%-enc%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify LOLBins running with arguments typical of malicious payload delivery or defense evasion.
config.expected_signal: Signed binaries with complex command lines. Silence proves no targeted LOLBin execution matched these patterns on the scoped hosts.

primitive_config.label: Proxied system binary execution
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{lolbin_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%.dll%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%http%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%-enc%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Signed binaries with complex command lines. Silence proves no targeted LOLBin execution matched these patterns on the scoped hosts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, activity_name, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', time) AS hour_bin, COUNT(*) AS file_ops FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, activity_name, hour_bin HAVING file_ops > {{file_op_threshold}} ORDER BY file_ops DESC
config.description: Identify mass renames or writes that characterize ransomware encryption.
config.expected_signal: Hosts with hundreds or thousands of file operations in a one-hour window. Silence proves no mass file activity occurred on monitored hosts.

primitive_config.label: High-volume file operations
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, activity_name, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', time) AS hour_bin, COUNT(*) AS file_ops FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, activity_name, hour_bin HAVING file_ops > {{file_op_threshold}} ORDER BY file_ops DESC
primitive_config.expected: Hosts with hundreds or thousands of file operations in a one-hour window. Silence proves no mass file activity occurred on monitored hosts.

config.objective: Determine if any host shows the complete pattern: successful anomalous authentication followed by proxy binary execution and/or mass file operations.
config.description: Determine if the sign-in, LOLBin usage, and file activity together indicate an active ransomware intrusion.
config.expected_signal: A high-confidence verdict per host citing specific sign-ins and process chains.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign per host.

config.question: the final-triage verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the final-triage verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.description: Direct the workflow to containment or manual review based on the correlated findings.
Stop the ransomware spread immediately upon high-confidence detection.
config.instructions: Isolate the host immediately to prevent further file encryption or lateral movement. Revoke the credentials for the identified compromised account.

config.description: Provide human oversight for suspicious or indeterminate results.
config.instructions: Review the correlated evidence from authentication, process activity, and file operations. If malicious, ensure isolation was completed and initiate the full ransomware recovery playbook.

config.description: Finalize the hunt when no malicious activity is found.
config.instructions: Record the findings. If the sign-in was suspicious but no endpoint activity followed, consider monitoring the account for future anomalies.
